- issues opened in `story-repo`#5 ("Results for M1–M6 and R1 (preliminary): H1 not supported at default budget; R1 negative as pre-registered") by `experiment-repo`  > Results for the claims (preliminary on pending parts; tables on paper-repo `dev` under `results/tables`, dictionary in `results/README.md`). Nothing here is a claim you must adopt; where a result is negative I report it as such.
  > 
  > - **M2/M3 (reliability at the default budget; H1).** At shap's default budget (German d=20, ACS-Employment d=16; d ≤ 10 default = exact enumeration) the share of instances with exact top-3 P_c ≥ 0.9 is 0.90–1.00 (LR 1.00, RF 0.90, GBM 0.92/0.97, MLP 0.95); the tolerance-aware P_c^ε(0.05) share is 1.00 in all eight cells. So the H1 gap (high Pearson, lower top-k correctness) is ≈ 0 at default budgets (contrast ≤ 10 points, mostly < 5): H1 is **not supported at the default budget** under the pre-registered 10-point rule; it holds at smaller budgets (exact-top-3 contrast ≥ 10 points with CI above 0 in 274 of 464 cells, tolerance-aware 121). The headline "reliable on most cells at the default budget" branch of the Outline fits; the failure region is small budgets and `num_features(10)` (share 0.68–0.87) / `auto` bias.
  > - **M4/M5.** φ-error slope vs m: kernel_paired ≈ −0.5; shap `l1_reg=False` −0.7 (ill-conditioned below m ≈ 3d); `num_features(10)` ≈ 0 (biased, does not converge). m* vs margin: median log-log slope −1.07 for kernel_paired vs the −2 predicted, with censored instances excluded (see `mstar_fit.csv`): the m* ∝ 1/g² claim is **not confirmed as stated**; report the fitted slope and c with CI.
  > - **M6.** Top-3 agreement between two runs at the default budget 0.94–1.00; between exact explanations under a different 50-row background 0.57–0.69 (German/ACS-Employment) and under retrained models 0.14–0.83: sampling noise is far below the background and model floors.
  > - **R1.** Negative as pre-registered (primary contrast: certificate vs run-twice's first run, Brier on exact top-3 correctness, instance bootstrap): the check is worse in all 20 dataset×model cells (+0.014 to +0.052 Brier, CI above 0, held-out instances and leave-one-dataset-out agree). The variance estimator is calibrated (coverage 0.93–0.95). Matched-deliverable variant (run-twice delivers the mean of its two runs, same accuracy as the 2m run): check wins in 19 of 20 cells (−0.009 to −0.028; one cell below the 0.01 margin). Two agreeing runs are correct only 0.77–0.80 of the time at German/ACS-Employment; the certificate's calibrated 0.9 stop is calibrated (0.95–0.96 correct among stops) and saves ≈ 25 % evaluations vs a flat run of equal accuracy there. Suggest R1 as a labelled section with both contrasts stated, not in the abstract.
  > - **Cuts**: R = 100 except German LR 30, German/ACS-Employment MLP 60, ACS-Employment LR 30; German GBM 37/40 pending; m ∈ {32,64,128} for RF/GBM at d ≥ 16 and background sensitivity pending.
